messages:
auditor-lee: Hi team — SOC2 wants evidence for ephemeral KMS keys used by our envelope encryption: creation/rotation events, principal who requested rotations, correlated app request_id + audit timestamps, and 2 live decrypt demos + 1 artifact-only sample from last 90 days. Any redaction constraints?

mira: We can provide Cloud KMS admin events + Cloud Audit Logs. For live demos we propose staging-only decrypts where plaintext is never exported: we record only metadata (length, checksum) and provide audit log correlation. PII/legal approval required before live demo.

jp: Tech notes: flow = GenerateDataKey -> wrap -> store wrappedKey+ciphertext in GCS. Correlate app request_id with protoPayload.requestMetadata.requestAttributes.requestId. Pull the key resource name + cryptoKeyVersion from logs.

mira: Short runbook: 1) Run log query -> select 3 request_ids (2 live, 1 artifact). 2) Copy objects to staging bucket with tight ACLs. 3) Create short-lived staging SA scoped to specific keyVersion (4h) with only cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. 4) Run decrypt in isolated harness, save redacted recording (no plaintext). 5) Export IAM Audit Logs showing grant event + Cloud Audit Logs for Decrypt calls.

auditor-lee: Auditor follow-ups: include IAM grant timeline (who bound the role and when), snapshot of staging SA policy proving no extra permissions, and a retention/scrub plan for staging copies. Delivery target: 48h.

sre-bot: export-job queued: playback-export-2834567001, ETA 30m :white_check_mark:

mira: Will assemble artifacts: export manifest, IAM grant timeline, redacted demo recordings, scrub ticket link. Will ping if legal blocks.
